answers.core: Requires internal changes to SceneTreeDock class in editor source code.
answers.workaround: I'm honestly not sure how often people use this utility, as I don't really use Godot all that much (yet), but it definitely threw me for a loop the first time I tried it, and I'll bet I'm not the only one. You *can* just move the node after-the-fact, but it still *feels* like a bug. In fact, I almost opened this as a bug report, but I think it's still *technically* an enhancement since everything is functioning as it should in a literal sense.

title: "Reparent to New Node" moves node unexpectedly in single-branch case.
